desc:
Welcome to Everblue Dungeon!

Enter an anime action RPG filled with powerful weapons, fierce enemies, and challenging bosses. Build your team, master flashy skills, and grow stronger with every dungeon run!

Swap weapons and unleash devastating combos
Collect characters, companions, and rare loot
Upgrade your gear and customize your build
Team up with friends to conquer dangerous dungeons  

Your next adventure begins in Everblue.
